item.title: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal gives an update on Temple device
item.summary: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal revealed the Temple wearable device is now smaller and more powerful. Pre-orders for the limited launch edition will begin very soon. The device is expected to ship before the end of 2026. PV Sindhu was recently seen wearing the Temple device at a championship. This device tracks blood flow and oxygenation inside the brain.
